description: This file defines the class PdfStringObject, which represents an indirect text string in a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors, properties for encoding and value, and internal methods for handling raw bytes and Unicode rereading.

classes.name: PdfStringObject
classes.description: Represents an indirect text string value in a PDF document, with properties for encoding, value, and raw byte handling.
